description: URGENT: Fix 11s+ compilation times on /world/[id] route. Target: <20ms compilation, <100ms render

userStories.title: Diagnose root cause of 11s compilation
userStories.description: Identify why /world/[id] takes 11s to compile. Check for large imports, missing code splitting, circular dependencies, or client/server boundary violations
acceptanceCriteria: Identify exact components causing slow compile
userStories.notes: Use semantic search: /toolkit search 'world route compilation bottleneck'

userStories.title: Implement dynamic imports for MapLibre
userStories.description: MapLibre is heavy and should be dynamically imported with ssr: false to prevent server-side bundling
acceptanceCriteria: MapLibre dynamically imported in map component

userStories.title: Fix client/server component boundaries
userStories.description: Ensure proper separation - server components should not import client components directly, causing entire route to be client-bundled
acceptanceCriteria: No server components importing client components
userStories.notes: Check world editor, sidebar, pin components

userStories.title: Add React.memo to expensive components
userStories.description: Prevent unnecessary re-renders of map, pins, and sidebar components
acceptanceCriteria: Pin markers use memoization (already done, verify)

userStories.title: Configure Next.js build optimizations
userStories.description: Enable all performance features in next.config.js and package.json

userStories.title: Benchmark and verify improvements
userStories.description: Measure before/after performance to confirm fixes work
